shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
Walking in the park is my favorite activity.
Cooking new recipes can be quite fun.
Traveling to new places teaches us a lot.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
Gardening is a rewarding hobby for many people.
Volunteering in the community brings joy to others.
Watching movies with friends is a great way to bond.
Practicing a new language opens up many opportunities.
Learning to play an instrument requires patience and practice.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about artistic hobbies.
questions: Q1: What artistic hobbies do you enjoy?
Q2: What challenges do you face while pursuing these hobbies?
Q3: How important do you think art is in daily life?
Q4: What advice would you give someone starting an artistic hobby?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: What actions do you take to be more environmentally friendly?
Q2: What difficulties do people face in adopting sustainable practices?
Q3: Why do you think environmental awareness is crucial today?
Q4: What recommendations would you make to encourage others to be eco-friendly?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical eating habits?
Q2: What challenges do you encounter with maintaining healthy eating?
Q3: In your opinion, how does diet affect overall health?
Q4: What tips would you suggest for someone wanting to improve their diet?
